<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'apt-cache search "clang.*rt" 2>/dev/null; apt-cache search "compiler-rt" 2>/dev/null; apt-cache search "llvm.*rt" 2>/dev/null | head -10' 2>&1 | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
